requirements.text: Both web and API roster downloads must contain exactly Visit ID, Site, Scheduled at, and Inspector name, encoded as UTF-8 CSV. Inspector mobile must be absent from the header and every record. Preserve district isolation.

Each successful download records exactly ACTOR_ID, DISTRICT_ID, ROW_COUNT, UTC_TIMESTAMP and EXPORT_FORMAT_VERSION=roster-csv-v2. Audit metadata never contains the CSV payload. Denied and unavailable downloads produce no success audit row.
When current export is unavailable, both download routes must return 503 without CSV or a success audit row. Remove the legacy fallback. A caller with no district access must still be denied.
Release follow-up must document the current roster columns and explain district selection. Keep implementation separate from the shared export service.
Release follow-up must provide an enablement checklist and explain the disabled state so operators can verify no old fallback.
Keep unrelated scheduling keyboard help work active in its existing owner scope.
